title: Reject duplicate Multi-Site egress entries after normalization

opportunity.rootCause: Egress allowlists were cardinality-bounded and syntax-checked but duplicate hosts, ports, and schemes were still accepted. Host casing/trailing dots and scheme casing could represent the same policy value more than once.
opportunity.risk: Duplicate policy entries increase persisted and runtime metadata without adding capability and can make configuration intent ambiguous across configuration and database snapshot paths.

implementation.behavior: Configuration and typed snapshot validation now reject duplicate egress hosts after hostname normalization, duplicate ports, and duplicate schemes after case normalization.

red.result: failed 1/1 because duplicate egress entries were accepted by both validation paths

verification.multiSiteRegression: passed 266/266 across 99 executable test classes; external PostgreSQL fault-injection and non-test filename placeholders were not executable suite classes

boundary: PostgreSQL-backed integration and live duplicate-policy persistence/reload were not run in this environment
Authenticated browser and published-EXE smoke were not run
Visual responsive, screen-reader, CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode, and production certification remain unverified
